question: Who among the following won the Best Male Singer National Award at the 67th National Film Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is **B Praak.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **B Praak **won the best male singer National Award at **67th National film award.**
 
• **B Praak ** won this award for **Teri Mitti **song in **Kesri **movie.
 
• **B Praak **won IIFA Award, Mirchi music award for Album of the year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some other winner of 67th National Film award.​__**

 Bardo (Marathi)

 Gumnaami
